// ---------- FastReader ----------
class FastReader {
    char buf[1<<20];
    int idx, n;
public:
    FastReader() { idx = n = 0; }
    char getc() {
        if (idx == n) {
            idx = 0;
            n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof(buf), stdin);
            if (n == 0) return EOF;
        }
        return buf[idx++];
    }
    int nextInt() {
        int x = 0;
        char c = getc();
        while (c <= ' ') c = getc();
        bool neg = false;
        if (c == '-') { neg = true; c = getc(); }
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = getc();
        }
        return neg ? -x : x;
    }
    long long nextLong() {
        long long x = 0;
        char c = getc();
        while (c <= ' ') c = getc();
        bool neg = false;
        if (c == '-') { neg = true; c = getc(); }
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = getc();
        }
        return neg ? -x : x;
    }
    double nextDouble() {
        double x = 0.0;
        char c = getc();
        while (c <= ' ') c = getc();
        bool neg = false;
        if (c == '-') { neg = true; c = getc(); }
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = getc();
        }
        if (c == '.') {
            c = getc();
            double frac = 1.0;
            while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                frac /= 10;
                x += (c - '0') * frac;
                c = getc();
            }
        }
        return neg ? -x : x;
    }
    string nextLine() {
        string s;
        char c = getc();
        while (c == '\n') c = getc();
        while (c != '\n' && c != EOF) {
            s += c;
            c = getc();
        }
        return s;
    }
};

// ---------- Pair ----------
struct Pair {
    int i, j;
    Pair(int i, int j) : i(i), j(j) {}
    bool operator==(const Pair& o) const {
        return i == o.i && j == o.j;
    }
};

// ---------- Node ----------
struct Node {
    int data, open, close;
    Node() : data(0), open(0), close(0) {}
    Node(int data, int open, int close) : data(data), open(open), close(close) {}
};

// ---------- ST ----------
class ST {
    int n;
    Node* st;
public:
    ST(int n) : n(n) {
        int size = 1;
        while (size < n) size <<= 1;
        st = new Node[4 * size];
    }
    void build(Node nodes[]) {
        build(0, 0, n - 1, nodes);
    }
private:
    void build(int id, int l, int r, Node nodes[]) {
        if (l == r) {
            st[id] = nodes[l];
            return;
        }
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        build((id << 1) + 1, l, mid, nodes);
        build((id << 1) + 2, mid + 1, r, nodes);
        st[id] = comb(st[(id << 1) + 1], st[(id << 1) + 2]);
    }
public:
    void update(int i, Node node) {
        update(0, 0, n - 1, i, node);
    }
private:
    void update(int id, int l, int r, int i, Node node) {
        if (i < l || r < i) return;
        if (l == r) {
            st[id] = node;
            return;
        }
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        update((id << 1) + 1, l, mid, i, node);
        update((id << 1) + 2, mid + 1, r, i, node);
        st[id] = comb(st[(id << 1) + 1], st[(id << 1) + 2]);
    }
public:
    Node get(int x, int y) {
        return get(0, 0, n - 1, x, y);
    }
private:
    Node get(int id, int l, int r, int x, int y) {
        if (x > r || y < l) return Node();
        if (x <= l && r <= y) return st[id];
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        return comb(get((id << 1) + 1, l, mid, x, y), get((id << 1) + 2, mid + 1, r, x, y));
    }
    Node comb(Node a, Node b) {
        int min_ = min(a.open, b.close);
        return Node(a.data + b.data + min_ * 2, a.open + b.open - min_, a.close + b.close - min_);
    }
};

// ---------- Utility functions ----------
static long long comb(int n, int c) {
    if (c > n) return 0;
    if (c == n) return 1;
    long long ans = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < c; i++) {
        ans *= (n - i);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= c; i++) {
        ans /= i;
    }
    return ans;
}

static double cal(int m, int n) {
    long long ttl = comb(n, 3);
    double ans = 0.0;
    ans += (double)comb(m, 3);
    ans += (double)(comb(m, 2) * comb(n - m, 1));
    ans += 0.5 * (double)(comb(m, 1) * comb(n - m, 2));
    return ans / ttl;
}

static long long pow(long long a, long long b, int mod) {
    long long pow = 1, x = a % mod;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) pow = (pow * x) % mod;
        x = (x * x) % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return pow;
}

static bool isPrime(long long N) {
    if (N <= 1) return false;
    if (N <= 3) return true;
    if (N % 2 == 0 || N % 3 == 0) return false;
    for (long long i = 5; i * i <= N; i += 6) {
        if (N % i == 0 || N % (i + 2) == 0) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static vector<int> manacher(const string& s) {
    int n = s.size();
    vector<int> d1(n);
    for (int i = 0, l = 0, r = -1; i < n; i++) {
        int k = (i > r) ? 1 : min(d1[l + r - i], r - i + 1);
        while (0 <= i - k && i + k < n && s[i - k] == s[i + k]) k++;
        d1[i] = k--;
        if (i + k > r) {
            l = i - k;
            r = i + k;
        }
    }
    return d1;
}

static vector<int> kmp(const string& s) {
    int n = s.size();
    vector<int> res(n);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        int j = res[i - 1];
        while (j > 0 && s[i] != s[j]) j = res[j - 1];
        if (s[i] == s[j]) ++j;
        res[i] = j;
    }
    return res;
}

    while (l < r) {
        int m = (l + r) / 2;
        double x = cal(m, n);
        if (x >= p) r = m;
        else l = m + 1;
    }

}
